items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: No, I didn't know too much about them.

ctx.x: Did you encounter any musicians over there who eventually went on to any fame? Like, I believe Arsenio Rodriguez... I don't know if that's too early for him. But he was a musician from Cuba who was very well-known; certainly in the Thirties he became known in this country. Did you know much about any particular musicians in the nightclubs?
No, I didn't know too much about them. Because we didn't get a chance to go around to nightclubs very much.
